lines: Thirty-five thousand years ago, someone made marks on a cave wall in northern Spain.
Since then, this corner of Europe has belonged to Phoenician traders, Roman legions, Visigoth kings and Muslim caliphs.
It built an empire on which the sun never set. Then it lost it, fought itself, and found its way to democracy.
This is the story of Spain, in twenty-three chapters.
From a painted cave in Altamira, to a king who saved a democracy.
That's thirty-five thousand years of Spain.
Which country should we tell next? Let us know in the comments. This was History Sketches.
